fns.desc: l2_packet_init(): if l2_packet_init_libpcap() fails after pcap_open_live() already succeeded (e.g. pcap_set_datalink/pcap_compile/pcap_setfilter failure inside l2_packet_init_libpcap), the caller only does eth_close(l2->eth) and os_free(l2) -- l2->pcap is never pcap_close()'d, unlike the normal l2_packet_deinit() path which does 'if (l2->pcap) pcap_close(l2->pcap);'. Leaks the pcap/BPF file descriptor on this error path.

l2_packet_init_libpcap(): pcap_compile() fills pcap_fp (allocates a BPF instruction array internally); if the subsequent pcap_setfilter() call fails, the function returns -1 at line 246 without ever calling pcap_freecode(&pcap_fp) (only reached on the success fallthrough at line 249). Leaks whatever pcap_compile() allocated.
